name: Euler Ancestral (flow / RF branch)
plain: What euler_ancestral silently becomes on a flow model. It interpolates toward x0 to a lower noise level, rescales the signal, and adds fresh noise so the sample sits back on the straight data-noise line. It has no name of its own: selection happens from the model type.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
RF step: ratio=1+(σ'/σ−1)η; σ_down=σ'·ratio; α'=1−σ'; α_down=1−σ_down; c=√(σ'²−σ_down²α'²/α_down²).
x_d=(σ_down/σ)x+(1−σ_down/σ)D; if η>0: x'=(α'/α_down)x_d+n·s_noise·c. s_noise is multiplied by model_sampling.noise_scale (default 1).

props.prediction_space: flow (linear interpolation σ between data and noise)
props.flow_const: This is the CONST path. Renoise formula differs from the VE one.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Reached via euler_ancestral on CONST models.
